import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'
import { resolve, join, extname } from 'node:path'
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
import { createServer } from 'node:http'
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'
import { child } from './session-lifecycle.mjs'
import { livePreviewScript, watchProject } from './live-preview.mjs'

export function projectType(root) {
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'package.json'))) {
    const p = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8'))
    if (p.dependencies?.next || p.devDependencies?.next) throw new Error('Unsupported framework: customize start.sh and provide static deployment output.')
    if (p.dependencies?.vite || p.devDependencies?.vite) return 'vite'
    throw new Error('Unsupported package project: customize start.sh and deployment output.')
  }
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) return 'html'
  throw new Error('No generated index.html or supported package project.')
}
export async function start(root = process.cwd()) {
  const type = projectType(root)
  const projectRoot = resolve(root)
  if (type === 'vite') {
    const stampDir = process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR || join(root, 'node_modules', '.cache')
    mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
    const stamp = join(stampDir, 'default-dependencies')
    const lock = join(root, 'package-lock.json')
    const hash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
    let old = ''
    try { old = readFileSync(stamp, 'utf8') } catch {}
    if (old !== hash || !existsSync(join(root, 'node_modules/vite'))) {
      await child('npm', [existsSync(lock) ? 'ci' : 'install', '--no-audit', '--no-fund'], { cwd: root })
      mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
      const installedHash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
      writeFileSync(stamp, installedHash)
    }
    await child(process.execPath, [join(root, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './'], { cwd: root })
    root = join(root, 'dist')
  }
  if (!existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) throw new Error('Static deployment output must contain index.html.')
  if (process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR) writeFileSync(join(process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR, 'deployment-output.json'), JSON.stringify({ project: projectRoot, directory: resolve(root) }))
  const mime = { '.html':'text/html', '.js':'application/javascript', '.css':'text/css', '.json':'application/json', '.svg':'image/svg+xml', '.png':'image/png', '.jpg':'image/jpeg', '.webp':'image/webp', '.wasm':'application/wasm', '.glb':'model/gltf-binary' }

  const server = createServer((req, res) => {

      } else res.end(content)
    } catch { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not found') }
  })
  server.on('close', () => { stopWatching(); clearInterval(keepAlive); buildWatcher?.kill(); for (const client of clients) client.end() })
  server.listen(Number(process.env.PORT || 3000), '0.0.0.0')

## Objective
- Build a playable browser prototype of the user's pitch: "An open-world survival game where the world remembers everything you do. NPCs adapt, enemies learn your strategies, and no two playthroughs are the same."

## Requirements
- User provided only the game concept; no explicit additional constraints.
- Must run in the OMGithub static/Vite playground and be verifiable in-browser.
- Mobile/touch support expected per repo conventions.

## Decisions
- Built a top-down 2D canvas survival game titled **The Remembering**.
- Core fantasy implemented via persistent localStorage ledger: deeds, witnesses, regional scars, NPC rumors, and six enemy doctrines that unlock based on player tactics.
- Procedural seeded world with settlements, ruins, shrines, camps, biomes, resources, day/night, weather.
- Persistence across death: dead characters are recorded; a new wanderer inherits world memory, doctrines, and bonus max HP.
- Enemy doctrines: Shieldwall (ranged kills), Slipstep (melee kills), Sappers (trap kills), Lantern Wardens (stealth kills), Scent Hounds (escapes), Ashwalkers (fire hits).
- Static HTML/CSS/ES modules; no external assets or frameworks.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` with title screen, HUD, minimap, quest card, hotbar, journal, crafting, dialogue, pause, death overlays, touch controls.
- `styles.css` full responsive UI, including mobile/touch layouts.
- `src/util.js`: constants, seeded RNG/noise, math/color helpers.
- `src/world.js`: island terrain, 3x3 named regions, settlements, ruins, shrines, camps, resources, spawn selection.
- `src/memory.js`: persistent memory ledger, reputation, doctrines, rumor generation, death/legacy serialization.
- `src/entities.js`: player/enemy/animal/NPC/projectile/trap/particle systems and adaptive AI behavior.
- `src/render.js`: painterly terrain prepaint, trees/rocks/structures/characters, lighting, weather, minimap, quest marker.
- `src/ui.js`: HUD updates, toasts/banners, journal/craft/dialogue/death rendering, panel state.
- `src/audio.js`: synthesized WebAudio ambience and SFX.
- `src/game.js`: orchestration, survival stats, combat, crafting, interactions, quest tutorial, director spawns, save/load, respawn, input, touch joystick.
- Server runs on `http://localhost:3002` via tmux session `remembering`.
- Title and gameplay screenshots captured: `screenshots/title.png`, `screenshots/game1.png`, `screenshots/game2.png`, `screenshots/adapt.png`.
- Browser loads with no JS console errors (only favicon 404).
- Verified: world generation, entering game, gathering stone/wood/fiber, crafting bow, tutorial scout spawn, bow kill, quest advancement, doctrine progress.
- Fixed duplicate `btn-resume` ID, added `btn-pause-close`, removed stale `checkAdaptation` calls, added quest marker renderer, corrected day/night warm overlay times.

### Active
- Visual polish after first gameplay screenshot: terrain looks blocky/tiled (especially rock biome), player character is low-contrast, controls hint is cramped/clipped, minimap fog is too dark.
- Verifying doctrine unlock banner and actual adaptive spawns after calling `gainTactic('rangedKills')`.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect `screenshots/adapt.png` and confirm doctrine unlock banner/patrol behavior.
2. Improve terrain painterliness: soften tile boundaries (blur pass or organic overlapping patches), add rock texture.
3. Improve player readability (outline/rim light/larger silhouette) and tidy bottom-left controls hint.
4. Lighten unexplored minimap fog and increase reveal radius slightly.
5. Test full tutorial dialogue with Keeper Maelin, death/respawn legacy flow, save/reload persistence, journal/craft panels, and mobile viewport/touch controls.
6. Re-screenshot desktop and mobile, then update README if appropriate.

## Relevant Files
- `src/game.js`: main orchestration, save/load, combat, quest, dialogue, respawn.
- `src/render.js`: canvas rendering, terrain, characters, lighting, minimap, quest marker.
- `src/entities.js`: enemy AI and doctrine behaviors.
- `src/memory.js`: ledger, doctrines, rumors, persistence schema.
- `src/world.js`: procedural map/POIs/resources.
- `src/ui.js`: DOM UI/panel rendering.
- `index.html`: all HUD/overlay markup.
- `styles.css`: visual design and responsive/touch layout.
- `src/audio.js`: synthesized audio.
- `src/util.js`: RNG/noise/constants/helpers.
- `screenshots/game1.png`: current gameplay visual baseline.
- `screenshots/adapt.png`: latest adaptation-state screenshot.

## Important Context
- Working directory is a git repo with all project files currently uncommitted.
- `start.sh` uses `RUNTIME_DIR` default static server; run with `PORT=3002 ./start.sh`.
- Playwright CLI initially failed expecting `chromium-1243`; fixed by symlinking `$HOME/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1243` → `chromium-1248`.
- Use `playwright-cli eval "() => { ... }"` with a function expression, not bare statements.
- Browser game debug handle: `window.__game`.
- Current save key: `the-remembering-save-v1`; localStorage may contain test progress from browser session.
- Known minor issue: enemy doctrine test showed `rangedKills` at 1/2 before direct `gainTactic` call; second arrow may have missed due to enemy movement.
- `memory.record` text is written in second person ("You ..."), and rumors strip the leading "You ".

input.content:
# The Remembering

A playable, no-build browser survival prototype built around one idea: **the world remembers everything you do.**

The valley is procedurally generated from a seed. You gather, hunt, craft, trade, and fight — and every deed is written into a persistent ledger. NPCs repeat what they have heard, settlements change their opinion of you, regions carry scars, and the Hollow adapt their tactics to the way you fight. When you die, the ledger does not close: a new wanderer inherits the world the last one made.

## Play

Open the project through OMGithub, or serve the folder with any static file server and visit it in a browser:

```bash
python3 -m http.server 3002
```

Then open `http://localhost:3002/`. No build step, framework, or external asset is required.

## Controls

| Input | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `WASD` / arrows | Move |
| Mouse | Aim |
| Left click | Strike / fire |
| `E` | Interact, gather, talk, loot |
| `1`–`4` | Select tool |
| `C` | Craft |
| `J` | Open the ledger |
| `Shift` | Crouch |
| `Space` | Dodge |
| `Q` | Eat |
| `Esc` | Close panels / pause |

Phones and tablets get a virtual joystick and touch action buttons; touch mode can also be toggled from the pause menu.

## What remembers

- **Deeds** — every kill, gift, craft, shrine, theft, and death is timestamped and attributed to a region.
- **Witnesses** — nearby NPCs carry word of what they saw.
- **Reputation** — each settlement tracks how it feels about you.
- **Regional scars** — scorched ground, hunted-out woods, Hollow hunting grounds.
- **Doctrines** — six enemy adaptations unlock from your habits: Shieldwall (ranged), Slipstep (melee), Sappers (traps), Lantern Wardens (stealth), Scent Hounds (escapes), and Ashwalkers (fire).
- **Legacy** — dead wanderers stay in the ledger, and a new character inherits world memory plus a small max-health bonus at higher legend tiers.

Progress is stored in `localStorage` under `the-remembering-save-v1`.

## Source map

- `index.html` — HUD, overlays, title, touch controls
- `styles.css` — responsive layout and visual design
- `src/game.js` — game loop, combat, crafting, quest, persistence
- `src/world.js` — seeded terrain, regions, points of interest, resources
- `src/memory.js` — persistent ledger, reputation, doctrines, rumors
- `src/entities.js` — player, enemies, animals, NPCs, adaptive AI
- `src/render.js` — painterly canvas renderer, lighting, weather, minimap
- `src/ui.js` — DOM panels, toasts, journal, dialogue, death screen
- `src/audio.js` — synthesized ambience and effects
- `src/util.js` — RNG, noise, math, palette helpers
